source: UNOSAT and GISTDA water extents, 1 August to 22 October 2024, Chiang Rai Province, Thailand (UNOSAT product 4009, event code FL20240912THA)

hdx.basis: HDX package metadata saved by the team on 2026-09-21; not fetched again for this record.

licence.name: CC BY-SA 4.0
licence.version_basis: Signed decision D2. HDX lists "cc-by-sa" without a version.
notes: HDX lists the licence as "cc-by-sa" and gives no version.
UNOSAT replied to the team's email with exactly: "we approve the use" (relayed by Putu on 2026-10-01).
The reply names no licence version and no credit wording, so derived layers ship under CC BY-SA 4.0 as signed in D2.
If UNOSAT later names a different version or credit wording, update this record, the notice file and every attribution.

provider_reply.note: The rights in this record rest on the public CC BY-SA licence and decision D2. The reply adds no rights beyond them; no missing right is inferred from it.

share_alike: Every layer or table derived from product 4009 is shared under CC BY-SA 4.0, in its own file, with the attribution and a change notice. Keeping product 4009 derivatives in their own files is a caution, not legal advice.

change_notice.template: Changed by FloodGuard: clipped to Mae Sai district ({clip_geometry}); geometry repaired ({repair_method}; {repair_count} parts repaired); reprojected from {source_crs} to {target_crs}; rasterised to {cell_size_m} m cells. Source: UNOSAT and GISTDA, FL20240912THA, UNOSAT product 4009, CC BY-SA 4.0.

steps.text: Repair invalid geometry (for example make_valid) and record how many parts were repaired.
Reproject from the source coordinate system to the stated target coordinate system.
Rasterise to the stated cell size.

use_in_this_track: read the Chiang Rai accumulated-water layer from the archive kept outside Git
clip, repair, reproject and rasterise it for Mae Sai district
show the result as a 2024 season envelope scenario layer (SCN-ENV) with its own credit and change notice
compare the illustrative replay model with the envelope as a plausibility comparison
limitations: Field_Validation=0: the product is preliminary and was not checked in the field. FloodGuard did not check it either.
The third-party satellite imagery that UNOSAT and GISTDA used to make the product is not relicensed by this record.
The HDX dataset is archived (metadata last modified 2026-02-17).
The accumulated layer's name ends 20241012, while the product text runs to 22 October 2024.
Decision D3: the accumulated layer is a scenario envelope only (SCN-ENV). It is never an observation for a single day.
The original UNOSAT message is not in the repository. File it as docs/provider_response_logging_guide.md describes.
This record does not cover use as machine-learning labels or as a qualified reference.
No file derived from product 4009 goes into public web files until both owners confirm this record.
assumptions: CC BY-SA 4.0 is the version that applies, because HDX lists none and UNOSAT's reply names none (decision D2).
The archive on disk is the file HDX distributed; its SHA-256 and size match the team's checksum record of 2026-09-21.
confidence_reason: The archive hash and size are verified and D2 is signed, but neither HDX nor UNOSAT's reply names the licence version or a credit wording.

decision_refs.summary: Rights record for UNOSAT/GISTDA product 4009 under CC BY-SA 4.0, with attribution, ShareAlike and a change notice.
The August to October accumulated layer is scenario-only (SCN-ENV), never an observation for a replay day.
Email C was sent; UNOSAT replied "we approve the use" (relayed by Putu, 1 Oct 2026).

signed_decision.how_recorded: The decision log says Putu approved the draft in a Claude Code session on behalf of both signers, and that Rachmania has not signed the log file directly.

owner_confirmation.note: This file transcribes signed decision D2. The owners have not yet confirmed the transcription.
owner_confirmation.how_to_confirm: Both owners read this file and the notice. Then set status to confirmed, list both names in confirmed_by, set confirmed_on (YYYY-MM-DD), set record_status to confirmed, set signed_by_human and human_rights_clearance to true, and remove the draft status lines from the notice file, all in one commit.
